'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Mike Klarenbeek LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Klarenbeek]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Klarenbeek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
